name: On/Off Keypad
description: A wall keypad that switches its connected light fixture on and off and adds extra buttons for controlling other Insteon devices or scenes. It replaces a standard wall switch. Insteon sells it in a 6-button version.

steps.text: At the circuit breaker or fuse panel, turn off the power for all circuits in the switch junction box, and verify that the power is off by trying to turn on the lights controlled by the switches.
Remove the trim plate, unscrew the switch you are replacing and pull it out of the junction box.
Disconnect the wires from the old switch; if they cannot be unscrewed, cut them where they enter the switch and strip 1/2 in. of insulation off the ends.

For a circuit with one switch, identify and connect the line, load, neutral and ground wires per the wiring diagram: the keypad's black wire to line, red wire to the load, white wire to neutral and bare copper wire to ground. A neutral connection is required; the load connection is optional.
Make sure all wire connectors are firmly attached and no copper is exposed except the ground wire.
With the SET button at the bottom, gently place the keypad into the junction box and screw it into place.
Turn the power back on at the circuit breaker or fuse panel.
Verify the keypad works by turning the light on and off.
Reinstall the trim plate.

notes: If there is no neutral wire in the junction box, consult an electrician.

In a virtual multi-way circuit only the primary keypad connects to the load; secondaries connect to line, neutral and ground and their red load wire is capped. The On/Off Keypad 2487S Owner's Manual gives the full multi-way wiring; then set up a control group so all the switches stay in sync.

Pull the SET button out about 1/8 in. to open the air gap and remove power from the keypad and its load; when pushing it back in, do not hold it in for more than a second or you may perform a factory reset.

steps.text: Tap the scene button you want to link.
Press and hold the SET button until the keypad beeps.
steps.expect: The scene button's LED blinks and all lit LEDs brighten to 100%; the keypad stays in linking mode for four minutes

notes: As a controller: after putting the keypad in linking mode, adjust the responder to the desired state, then press and hold the responder's SET button until it beeps or its LED or load flashes; the keypad double-beeps, the scene button's LED stops blinking and the LEDs return to normal brightness.

As a responder: press and hold the controller's button until it beeps, tap the keypad's scene button until its LED is in the desired state (for the On and Off buttons, tap the desired load state), then press and hold the keypad's SET button until it double-beeps; the scene button's LED flashes once.
With the Insteon app, press and hold the keypad's SET button until it double-beeps when the app prompts you.
The 3-second hold time comes from the KeypadLinc Line Developer Notes; software can send the Enter Linking Mode command for the same result.

steps.text: Set each responder to the desired scene state.
Tap the scene button on the keypad.
Press and hold the SET button until the keypad beeps.
steps.expect: The scene button's LED blinks and all lit LEDs brighten to 100%

steps.text: Tap the SET button.
steps.expect: The scene button's LED keeps blinking

steps.text: For each responder, tap its button if it is a multi-button device, then press and hold its SET button until it beeps or its LED flashes (about 3 seconds).
Tap the SET button.
steps.expect: The scene button's LED stops blinking and the LEDs return to normal brightness

steps.text: Test the scene by tapping the scene button a couple of times.
Tap the scene button on the keypad.
Press and hold the SET button until the keypad beeps.
steps.expect: The scene button's LED blinks and all lit LEDs brighten to 100%

steps.text: Press and hold the SET button until the keypad beeps again.
steps.expect: The scene button's LED keeps blinking; the keypad is in unlinking mode

notes: As a controller: then, if the responder has several buttons, tap the one to remove, and press and hold the responder's SET button until it double-beeps; the keypad double-beeps and its scene LED stops blinking.
As a responder: put the controller in unlinking mode first, tap the keypad button you are removing, then press and hold the keypad's SET button until it double-beeps.
To remove several responders at once, tap the SET button after entering unlinking mode, press and hold each responder's SET button until it beeps (about 3 seconds), then tap the SET button to finish.

steps.text: Pull the SET button out to open the air gap.
Wait 10 seconds.
Push the SET button in and hold it in.
Release the SET button.
steps.expect: After a couple of seconds the keypad double-beeps, the LEDs return to normal brightness and the connected load turns on

steps.text: Remove the keypad from all of its scene controllers.
Remove the scene memberships of every responder the keypad controls.

notes: The On/Off Keypad 2487S Owner's Manual says to remove the keypad from all of its scene controllers before you stop using it, and to remove responders you no longer use from its scenes, otherwise devices keep retrying commands and create network delays.
HouseLinc also lists its identity under 2487S-50.
Group 1 is the On and Off buttons, which control the load. In the 8-button layout, which software can set, groups 1 to 8 are buttons A to H.
Group 9 controls the load only while it's detached from group 1.
